data.introduction: Explore the 8-bit platform that starts the Logix story. From its processor to its peripheral ecosystem, one connected system at a time.
data.context: Logix launches Aurelia as a complete personal-computing platform: hardware, enhanced CP/M, AION applications, developer programs, support and the Computer Academy.

timeline.title: NCC 1978
timeline.description: Aurelia launches with FlexiBUS, enhanced CP/M 1.4 and the separately offered BPI business suite.

timeline.title: NCC 1979
timeline.description: Microsoft BASIC for Aurelia premieres alongside the Apple II interoperability products.

timeline.title: COMDEX 1979
timeline.description: Aurelia+ arrives alongside Pulse and Abacus 2.0; Monitor II options become available.

timeline.title: Software direction
timeline.description: Artemis becomes the primary AION software platform; Aurelia receives maintenance and simplified refreshes.

timeline.title: NCC 1981
timeline.description: An optional network adapter and CP/M upgrade add business networking.

notes.hardware: AION system controller contains DMA, bank control and independent system refresh. Video uses 16 KiB DRAM plus exclusive 1 KiB sprite SRAM.
notes.peripherals: Compatible choices, not simultaneous port occupancy. Later accessories show their introduction dates; they were not included at the original launch.
notes.software: Explore system internals, the Business Tools cartridge and independent software offerings. Introduction dates are shown; later editions are not implied at launch.
notes.memory: Logical CPU windows map physical banks. DMA latches physical banks; all installed DRAM is refreshed. Sprite SRAM uses separate video ports and is not application RAM.
notes.bundles: Bundle decomposition. Existing offers and proposed packages are labeled separately. Listed dates prevent later software from being implied at launch; prices are not assumed.
notes.portability: Shared application code and C APIs; separate target binaries, startup code and libraries. Optional emulator/debugging features are not guaranteed launch components.
